Use Citadel Rapid Transit to travel quickly between major locations. As you explore the Citadel, more locations will unlock.

Move [UI_XBoxB_Btn_LS] to highlight a reply on the conversation wheel.
Press [UI_XBoxB_Btn_A] to select it.
Run to the waypoint to take cover behind the rock.
Press [XBoxB_Btn_Y] to use medi-gel to heal your squad.

Some locked objects require Decryption or Electronics to access. If any squad member has the required talent, you will be able to unlock the object using the Decryption or Electronics interface or by spending Omni-gel.
Repeat the sequence of button presses before time expires.
Use [XBoxB_Btn_Back] to draw or holster your weapon.
Enter cover by moving up to the rock with your weapon drawn.

Approaching a low object will make you crouch to take cover behind it.
Click [XBoxB_Btn_L3] to manually toggle crouching.
Crouching improves weapon stability and aim.
To change your team's equipment, press the [XBoxB_Btn_Start] button to access the Mission Computer, then select the Equipment screen.

The Equipment screen allows you to equip and upgrade gear for your squad. 
Press [UI_XBoxB_Btn_DPadL] or [UI_XBoxB_Btn_DPadR] to cycle item types. 
Use [UI_XBoxB_Btn_DPadU] and [UI_XBoxB_Btn_DPadD] to select an item. 
[UI_XBoxB_Btn_A] equips the selected item. 
[UI_XBoxB_Btn_X] upgrade an equipped item. 
[UI_XBoxB_Btn_Y] breaks down the selected item into omni-gel.

Move to the edge of cover and press [XBoxB_Btn_RT] to fire.
Hold [XBoxB_Btn_LT] to lean out  and aim.

Press [XBoxB_Btn_RT] to pop up and fire from behind low cover.
Hold [XBoxB_Btn_LT] to pop up and aim from behind low cover.
Use [XBoxB_Btn_RT] to fire. Sustained fire causes weapons to overheat.
Press the [XBoxB_Btn_Start] button to access the Mission Computer and view Journal and Codex entries.
Pull [XBoxB_Btn_LS] back to move out of cover.

As you gain levels, use the Squad screen to improve your team's abilities.
Press the [XBoxB_Btn_Start] button to access the Mission Computer, then select the Squad screen.

Important locations are marked on your map.  
Open the Mission Computer with [XBoxB_Btn_Start] to access it.
Press the [XBoxB_Btn_Start] button to access the Mission Computer, then go to the Squad screen to spend talent points for new squad members.

Hold [XBoxB_Btn_RB] to bring up the Power wheel. 
The Power wheel lets you use the powers and special abilities of your squad.

Use [UI_XBoxB_Btn_RS] to aim at a target.
Select a power with [UI_XBoxB_Btn_LS] and press [UI_XBoxB_Btn_A] to use it.

Medi-gel is needed to heal injured squad members.
Omni-gel can be used to bypass Decryption and Electronics challenges.
Both can be acquired by defeating enemies and opening containers.

Use [XBoxB_Btn_DPad] to issue orders to your squad:
[XBoxB_Btn_DPadU]: Attack your target.
[XBoxB_Btn_DPadL] or [XBoxB_Btn_DPadR]: Have a specific squadmate move to a point or attack the targetted enemy.
[XBoxB_Btn_DPadD]: Regroup and follow you.

Press [XBoxB_Btn_DPadL] or [XBoxB_Btn_DPadR] to send a squadmate ahead.
Press [XBoxB_Btn_DPadD] to call them back.

The Squad screen lets you view your team's talents. 
Use [UI_XBoxB_Btn_DPad] to select a talent or its rank.
Press [UI_XBoxB_Btn_A] to spend a Talent Point to gain a rank in the selected talent.
As you gain levels, you will acquire Talent Points and unlock higher ranks.
Hold [XBoxB_Btn_A] while moving to storm forward rapidly while in combat.

Use [XBoxB_Btn_LT] to aim. 
Aiming increases your accuracy.
Press [XBoxB_Btn_X] to throw a grenade, and press it again to detonate it.

In the Normandy's vehicle bay, using a squad member's locker allows you to assign equipment to them. 
New equipment may be purchased from the Requisition Officer.

In the Mako:
[XBoxB_Btn_RB] fires the main cannon.
[XBoxB_Btn_RT] fires the coaxial machine gun.
[XBoxB_Btn_LT] zooms.
[XBoxB_Btn_A] fires the jump jets.
[XBoxB_Btn_X] returns you to the Normandy from an uncharted world.
You cannot exit the Mako unless it is parked and on level terrain.
Press [XBoxB_Btn_Y] to repair the Mako using omni-gel.
Hold [XBoxB_Btn_LB] to switch weapons for your squad.

To change weapons, hold [XBoxB_Btn_LB].
Use [XBoxB_Btn_LS] to select a weapon and [XBoxB_Btn_A] to equip it.

Move the mouse to highlight a reply on the conversation wheel. 
Left-click to select it.
Press %FIRSTAID to use medi-gel to heal your squad.

Advance to the central core. 
Move the mouse to move around the ring.
Left-click and Right-click to move inward and outward.
Avoid the security programs.

Use %ZOOM to draw your weapon. 
Press %HOLSTERWEAPON to put it away.

Approaching a low object will make you crouch to take cover behind it.
Press %CROUCH to manually toggle crouching.
Crouching improves weapon stability and aim.
To change your team's equipment, press the [ %PAUSEMENU ] button to access the Equipment screen.

The Equipment screen allows you to equip and upgrade gear for your squad. 
Click the Filter tab to switch item types.
Select an item and click the Equip button to assign it.
Click on an equipped item's Upgrade slot to select an upgrade.
Click the Omni-Gel button to break down the selected item into omni-gel.

Move to the edge of cover and press %FIRE to fire.
Hold %ZOOM to lean out  and aim.

Press %FIRE to pop up and fire from behind low cover.
Hold %ZOOM to pop up and aim from behind low cover.
Use %FIRE to fire. Sustained fire causes weapons to overheat.
Press %PAUSEMENU and open the Journal to view your updated mission objectives.
Hold %BACKWARD to move out of cover.
